# Netsidian 0.5.0

This release redesigns agent access management, improves document and board creation, and makes memory references behave like real internal links.

- MCP & agents settings are restructured into connection, token creation, token management and expandable memory sections. A generated token replaces its own form in place with copy/dismiss controls and scoped access/expiry details. Creation and list errors stay local; a list refresh failure never discards the one-time secret. Read-only access remains the default; write and trash permissions stay explicit choices.
- Memory references now resolve as internal document links everywhere: reading surfaces, graph and backlinks use stable IDs, including legacy bare detail/reference IDs, without changing saved Markdown. Links display current document titles when known and protect missing IDs.
- New documents open in the Visual Markdown Editor with their first heading selected; heading-driven automatic filename updates remain in place.
- Board creation starts with a selected title and derives the folder location until the user explicitly edits it. Existing column and template controls are unchanged.
- A Refresh file list button reloads the current vault's documents, folders and attachments; it works for read-only vaults and disables safely during a manual refresh.
- Board, map, memo and memory-folder creation now uses a cryptographically random UUID fallback on plain HTTP origins. No credential generation changed.
- The default accent color is #70a4fb in both themes; explicit custom colors and blue presets remain available, and primary button text adapts to the accent for readable contrast.

## Downloads and deployment

Desktop archives cover Linux x64, Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon.
Linux requires GTK4 and WebKitGTK 6.0; Windows requires WebView2 Runtime. macOS
bundles are ad-hoc signed and are not Apple notarized. Each archive includes
installation instructions and the license. Verify downloads using `SHA256SUMS`.

```sh
docker run -d --name netsidian -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \
  -v netsidian-state:/netsidian-state ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.5.0
```

The Helm package uses chart version and application image tag `0.5.0`.
`docker-image.txt` records the immutable multi-platform image digest.
